    u64=lambda x: x & ((1<<64)-1)
    rdx=u64(n*0xf4243)
    rdx=u64(rdx+0x11)
    rdx=u64(rdx*rdx)
    rdx=u64(rdx+0xc)
    rdx=u64(rdx*0x4ec4ec4ec4ec4ec5)
    rdx=u64(rdx+0xc4ec4ec4ec4ec4ec)
    rax=0x13b13b13b13b13b0
    # cmp rdx, rax; jae => rax>=rdx unsigned
    return rax>=rdx, rdx

for n in range(1,60):
    ok,rdx=cond(n)
    if ok:
        print(n,hex(rdx))

mask=(1<<64)-1

def rdx_from_len(n):
    rdx=(n*0xf4243) & mask
    rdx=(rdx+0x11) & mask
    rdx=(rdx*rdx) & mask
    rdx=(rdx+0xc) & mask
    rdx=(rdx*0x4ec4ec4ec4ec4ec5) & mask
    rdx=(rdx+0xc4ec4ec4ec4ec4ec) & mask
    return rdx

for n in [0,1,2,10,26,27,40,100,1000,10000,100000,1000000]:
    rdx=rdx_from_len(n)
    print(n,hex(rdx))

# brute search for n up to 1e7 for any rdx <= rax
rax=0x13b13b13b13b13b0
mn=(None,None)
for n in range(0,2000000):
    rdx=rdx_from_len(n)
    if mn[0] is None or rdx < mn[0]:
        mn=(rdx,n)
    if rdx <= rax:
        print('hit',n,hex(rdx));
        break
else:
    print('no hit up to',2000000,'min',hex(mn[0]),'at',mn[1],'rax',hex(rax))
